quotes.quote: Turn your face to the sun and the shadows fall behind you.

quotes.quote: Too many people spend too much time trying to perfect something before they actually do it. Instead of waiting for perfection, run with what you go, and fix it along the way...

quotes.quote: Give light, and the darkness will disappear of itself.
quotes.author: Desiderius Erasmus

quotes.quote: Your heart is full of fertile seeds, waiting to sprout.
quotes.author: Morihei Ueshiba

quotes.quote: If you accept the expectations of others, especially negative ones, then you never will change the outcome.
quotes.author: Michael Jordan

quotes.quote: You don't look out there for God, something in the sky, you look in you.
quotes.author: Alan Watts

quotes.quote: Most of us have far more courage than we ever dreamed we possessed.
quotes.author: Dale Carnegie

quotes.quote: The books that help you most are those which make you think that most. The hardest way of learning is that of easy reading; but a great book that comes from a great thinker is a ship of thought, deep freighted with truth and beauty.
quotes.author: Pablo Neruda

quotes.quote: In oneself lies the whole world and if you know how to look and learn, the door is there and the key is in your hand. Nobody on earth can give you either the key or the door to open, except yourself.
quotes.author: Jiddu Krishnamurti

quotes.quote: You have power over your mind -- not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: Something opens our wings. Something makes boredom and hurt disappear. Someone fills the cup in front of us: We taste only sacredness.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.quote: 'There are only two ways to live your life. One is as though nothing is a miracle. The other is as though everything is a miracle.'
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: 'This life is what you make it. No matter what, you're going to mess up sometimes, it's a universal truth. But the good part is you get to decide how you're going to mess it up. Girls will be your friends - they'll act like it anyway. But just remember, some come, some go. The ones that stay with you through everything - they're your true best friends. Don't let go of them. Also remember, sisters make the best friends in the world. As for lovers, well, they'll come and go too. And baby, I hate to say it, most of them - actually pretty much all of them are going to break your heart, but you can't give up because if you give up, you'll never find your soulmate. You'll never find that half who makes you whole and that goes for everything. Just because you fail once, doesn't mean you're gonna fail at everything. Keep trying, hold on, and always, always, always believe in yourself, because if you don't, then who will, sweetie? So keep your head high, keep your chin up, and most importantly, keep smiling, because life's a beautiful thing and there's so much to smile about.'
quotes.author: Marilyn Monroe

quotes.quote: 'The opposite of love is not hate, it's indifference. The opposite of art is not ugliness, it's indifference. The opposite of faith is not heresy, it's indifference. And the opposite of life is not death, it's indifference.'
quotes.author: Elie Wiesel

quotes.quote: 'When one door of happiness closes, another opens; but often we look so long at the closed door that we do not see the one which has been opened for us.'
quotes.author: Helen Keller

quotes.quote: Life Is Full of Obstacles, Stumble Upon !!
quotes.author: Pratik Shelar
